relocations.reason: Preserve exact executed bootstrap source bytes while storing the historical source snapshot with a .source.txt extension so it is not treated as product Python by repository Ruff.
relocations.historical_paths_policy: The original execution command, extraction/bootstrap snapshot path, run metadata, first report, and original manifest retain paths recorded at execution or first persistence. The historical bootstrap.py existed during execution; this path map records its later archive-only relocation to bootstrap.py.source.txt. No source formatting or execution replay was performed.
relocations.execution_scope: Relocation of persisted source evidence only; no lesson/figure change and no new readability verdict.
